worker.implementation_rule: imports frozen split, selection, fit, prediction, contract, integrity, and atomic checkpoint functions; applies the canonical loop body to one task

dry_run.note: The NPZ hashes differ only because fit_seconds is intentionally measured at runtime and is bound into the artifact digest.

execution.stability_concurrency: two candidate workers plus one reference worker
execution.first_attempt_disposition: A truncated process-table capture incorrectly suggested that the four original workers had disappeared. They remained alive. Four duplicate retries were briefly started, detected by a full process-table audit, and terminated before any checkpoint was written. The more advanced original workers were retained; no duplicate artifact was accepted.
execution.wake_lock_policy: A separate six-hour caffeinate assertion was started after the process-table audit. Completed artifacts only are eligible for canonical validation.
